_readme: Business details used across every page. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Contact details are published in structured data (JSON-LD) only while "verified" is true.
_formNote: Contact form delivery via FormSubmit (free). The first submission sends an activation email to the endpoint address; click the link once to activate. Afterwards you can replace the email in formEndpoint with the random alias FormSubmit provides, to keep the address out of the page source.
